{{Short description|Soviet and Russian mathematician (1940–2025)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=March 2025}}
'''Valeriy Iustinovich Oseledets''' ({{Langx|ru|Валерий Иустинович Оселедец|links=no}}; 25 May 1940 – 13 March 2025) was a Soviet and Russian mathematician.

== Biography ==
Oseledets was born on 25 May 1940, in the [[Soviet Union]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Персоналии: Оселедец Валерий Иустинович |url=https://www.mathnet.ru/rus/person17705 |access-date=2023-11-25 |website=www.mathnet.ru}}</ref> He completed his undergraduate program in 1962 from [[Moscow State University|Lomonosov Moscow State University]], where he studied probability theory.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Оселедец Валерий Иустинович |url=http://new.math.msu.su/department/probab/staff/oseledets.html |access-date=2023-11-25 |website=new.math.msu.su}}</ref> In 1965, he proved the [[Oseledets theorem|Oseledets Theorem]], named after himself. He received his Ph.D. under advisor [[Yakov Sinai]] in 1967.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Valery Oseledets - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=143706 |access-date=2023-11-25 |website=www.mathgenealogy.org}}</ref>

He was a faculty member and professor under the Department of Mechanics and Mathematics at Lomonosov Moscow State University.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Valery Oseledets |url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Valery-Oseledets-2}}</ref> His work primarily focused on [[statistical mechanics]], [[stochastic analysis]], [[dynamical system]]s, and [[probability]]. Oseledets died on 13 March 2025, at the age of 84.<ref>[https://math.msu.ru/node/2269 Скончался В.И. Оселедец] {{in lang|ru}}</ref>

== Awards ==
* '''[[Kolmogorov Prize]]''': he received this award in 2009.
